ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Progress Note 6 — Preventive Visit — John F. Kennedy

code.displayName: Periodic reevaluation and management of healthy individual

text.paragraph: Mr. Kennedy is a 31-year-old legislator with primary adrenal insufficiency on hydrocortisone and fludrocortisone, autoimmune hypothyroidism on levothyroxine, and chronic low back pain after lumbar disc surgery, who comes for his yearly preventive visit four months after his last review. His energy lasts through the working day. He has had no illness needing stress doses since the influenza in the winter, and he carries his injection kit and wears his medical ID. He swims three or four times a week, does his core exercises most days, and wears the brace only on long flights. He has no new concerns. [S]

Voluntary advance care planning discussion of about 20 minutes, with his consent. He wants full treatment in any emergency, and wants emergency staff to give hydrocortisone at once if he is found unwell; a copy of his emergency letter is in the chart and in his wallet. He named a health care agent, recorded in the confidential part of the chart and not named here, and chose not to record other treatment preferences today. To be revisited yearly. [S]
